theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 0 < n → 0 < ℓ → ∀ μ : Measure (Rn (n + ℓ)), IsFiniteMeasure μ → ∀ (Exc : Set (Rn (n + ℓ) × (Rn (n + ℓ) →L[ℝ] Rn (n + ℓ)))) (Bad : Set (Rn (n + ℓ) × (Rn (n + ℓ) →L[ℝ] Rn (n + ℓ)) × Rn (n + ℓ))), MeasurableSet Exc → MeasurableSet Bad → (∀ (a : Rn (n + ℓ)) (H : Submodule ℝ (Rn (n + ℓ))), finrank ℝ H = n + 1 → μHE[n] {θ | θ ∈ H ∧ ‖θ‖ = 1 ∧ (a, H.starProjection, θ) ∈ Bad} = 0) → (∀ (a : Rn (n + ℓ)) (W : Submodule ℝ (Rn (n + ℓ))), finrank ℝ W = n → (a, W.starProjection) ∈ Exc → ∀ u : Fin ℓ → Rn (n + ℓ), Orthonormal ℝ u → (∀ j, u j ∈ Wᗮ) → ∃ j, (a, (W ⊔ Submodule.span ℝ {u j}).starProjection, u j) ∈ Bad) → ForAlmostAllProjections (n + ℓ) n (fun p ↦ μ {a | (a, p) ∈ Exc} = 0)
